title: B1 Core capstone reading
subtitle: Produce a complete first-reading dossier for one paragraph.
overview: This capstone combines the B1 Core workflow: select a unit, map syntax and discourse, use a lexicon carefully, draft a translation, and state a limited reading conclusion.
The goal is responsible independence. A strong dossier distinguishes observation, translation, and interpretation instead of blending them.

sections.title: Capstone dossier
rows: List finite verbs and dependent constructions.
Map main claim, grounds, contrast, and purpose.
Offer a readable draft with a note on ambiguity.
State only what the paragraph’s evidence supports.

items.grc: ὁ λόγος τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῖς μὲν ἀπολλυμένοις μωρία ἐστίν, τοῖς δὲ σῳζομένοις δύναμις θεοῦ ἐστιν.
items.en: The word of the cross is folly to some, but to those being saved it is the power of God.

items.grc: γέγραπται γάρ· ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν.
items.en: For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise.”
